verdict.rationale: YPOG is a German law and tax advisory firm. Its offerings are legal advice, fund structuring, notary services and a software-supported transparency-register filing unit, not a hosted data platform. Letting users choose a data-storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows YPOG offers any configurable data-storage or residency feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
